items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Cause I remember when playing with him once, he threw his chair on another person sitting out there in the audience

ctx.x: Yeah. I never ask him about it. Yeah. When I saw him, it's not the thing to ask him. Yeah. But I know what, I, I, I, I really believe that he was the one who made the trouble.
Cause I remember when playing with him once, he threw his chair on another person sitting out there in the audience, taking a chair like this. He's kind of making trouble.
But you must have played with some other bands besides Keith Smith. Yeah.
